text.text_excerpt: What a great venue inside the Healing Center on St. Claude! I never would have known this was inside that building if it weren't for my friend D's performance here last weekend, but it's a venue with lots of room and a large stage. There was a piano on one side of the stage, a drum set that was pushed back, a DJ with his equipment, and after all that, there was still plenty of room for performers. The performance I was at was on the smaller, more intimate side, and the staff used their furniture strategically (more tables and chairs closer to the stage during the performance and moved them back to create room for dancing later on). There is also a balcony and there was art up there. My la...

Whenever someone says there's an event at Cafe Istanbul, I flash back to the 90s when it was a major club on Frenchmen Street. But no. This is a lovely theater inside the Healing Center building. And it is accessed from the back along St. Roch. There is a small parking lot that is accessed from N. Rampart. I was there for a charitable event with a variety of musical presenters... shout out to the dance group that finished their number by holding music streaming from a phone up to a mic when the sound system cut out. Sound was pretty good but at least one band was just too much for the small space. The bar prices were $$$ but maybe that's because the charity was getting a cut. Restrooms ou...

Experienced Cafe Istanbul for the first time in many many years. My, how New Orleans venues have changed! I went with a friend to Al "Carnival Time" Johnson's 80th Birthday Party here. The stage is easily visible from anywhere in the place. Room for dancing, chairs & tables for relaxing. Bar service is fast, bartender was pleasant. I didn't get a chance to try the food. I believe it was free for Al's birthday event. Bottom line, I'll definitely check out other performances here. I prefer the more I the more setting. Happy Birthday Al!
